newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela boosts security at oil plants on border.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela boosts security at oil plants on border.

text.p: Venezuela took steps Friday to boost security at oil installations near the border with Colombia to combat a recent spate of kidnappings by Colombian guerrillas.
"I have given precise instructions for reinforcements in this area of Apure state and in particular for security at oil plants," Defense Minister Pedro Nicolas Valencia told reporters.
Two oil engineers were snatched Wednesday in the La Victoria area of the southwestern Apure state by presumed Colombian guerrillas.
Kidnapping, smuggling and drug trafficking are common along Venezuela's 1,400-mile (2,200-km) border with Colombia.
